signals.text: Tonali struggles but Gonzalez impresses - player ratings for Tottenham v Newcastle. How Tottenham Hotspur and Newcastle United's players rated following Saturday's 2-0 win for the visitors in their Premier League match.

'We've got to do more' - Lampard frustrated by loss to Hull. Coventry manager Frank Lampard believes his side controlled possession but were "too slow" with the ball as their first top-flight home game in 25 years ends in a 1-0 defeat by Hull City.
Liverpool agree £123m deal for PSG's Barcola. Liverpool are closing in on a deal to sign forward Bradley Barcola, which will increase doubts over Cody Gakpo's future.
Gibbs-White shines - player ratings for Liverpool v Nottm Forest. How Liverpool and Nottingham Forest's players rated following their Premier League match.
